description:
- Search by postcode, city or address for nearby retailers. Each result
    shows the retailer's name, distance, address (with postcode) and phone
    number, and links directly to that retailer's own page.

elements.name: Search for a retailer by postcode and confirm results are returned with essential details

steps.name: I dismiss the newsletter popup if present
I fill in the "postcode search input" input field with "SW1A 1AA"
I click on the "retailer search button" button
the "first retailer result" should be displayed
the "first retailer result" should contain the text "miles"

elements.name: Clicking a retailer redirects to that retailer's own page

I click on the "retailer search button" button
I click on the "first retailer result" element
